jobs.title: Strategic Finance / Operations Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT TURN/RIVER

Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that partners with software businesses to drive AI transformation and catalyze capital-efficient growth. As a team of equal parts software operators and investors, we have the people, data-driven playbooks and flexible capital to re-architect engineering, product, go-to-market, talent and resourcing to build enduring value. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe.



About the Role

You will be the analytical partner for one of our portfolio companies. Investment and Operating Leads will bring you their hardest revenue questions: why retention moved, where new customer revenue actually comes from, which pricing change is worth making. Those questions often arrive half-formed. Your job is to find the real question, get the data, build the analysis, and deliver a recommendation that holds up in front of our Ops and Investment teams, a portfolio company CEO, or firm leadership. You will sit in a pod with a Data Analytics Lead who owns the portfolio company relationship and a platform team that builds the data pipes. You own the analysis, the dashboards, the recommendation, and its revenue impact.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own value-creation analysis for your portfolio company: retention and cohorts, pricing and packaging, pipeline and funnel yield, and revenue source mapping.

 - Build from raw data, not someone else’s summary. Pull and check the numbers yourself in SQL, our BI tools, and our AI agents.

 - Use AI to compress your cycle time, and flag what should be automated for everyone.

 - Turn findings into recommendations with a quantified revenue impact, a clear owner, and a next step.

 - Support new deals and add-ons when the deal team needs speed.

 - Turn any analysis that gets requested twice into a reusable template or tool for the portfolio and the whole Ops team.



Qualifications

 - 2-4 years of experience in SaaS FP&A or strategic finance, technology investment banking, or strategy consulting with software clients.

 - Command of SaaS economics: ARR bridges, gross and net retention, cohorts, pricing, and unit economics.

 - Experience building models from scratch and producing output that executives can use without rework.

 - Proficiency in SQL and comfort in messy, raw data; demonstrated ability to use AI tools or automation, ideally without being asked.

 - Structured thinker who can break complex revenue processes into systems of components, root causes, and dependencies.

 - Hands-on, execution-oriented, and accountable for results—this is a building role, not an advisory one.

 - Curious, experimental operator who takes feedback well and continuously tests new approaches and technologies

 - Experience owning a relationship with a CFO, CRO, or business unit leader is preferred



Location

 - San Francisco, hybrid work model



Compensation

 - The annual base salary range for this role is $145,000 - $155,000, taking into account numerous variable factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience, training, licensure, certifications, and organizational requirements.




BENEFITS AND PERKS

The below benefits are offered to full-time employees based out of our San Francisco office:

 - An opportunity to make an impact across multiple high-growth tech firms

 - Competitive salary and discretionary bonus

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance covered 100% for employee & dependents

 - Flexible vacation policy

 - 401K matching

 - Paid parental leave

 - Commuter benefits

 - Health and Wellness benefits

 - Household Services benefits

 - Home Office benefits

 - Annual Home Office Equipment Reimbursement

 - Donation matching

 - Work from home Monday & Friday

 - Energetic work environment with snacks and weekly team lunches 3x per week, centrally located near multiple public transit lines

 - A company that enjoys having fun: holiday parties, annual company offsite and retreat, annual summer "work from anywhere" month

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SSP Analytics, Seller Success Programs Analytics
jobs.jd: Are you looking for a role that allows you to shape the future of how new sellers launch and grow their businesses globally with Amazon? Do you like working in a start-up like environment with the opportunity to have a significant impact from day 1? Do you have an insatiable curiosity about why Amazon global stores operate as they do and how Amazon could optimize its selling partner experience? If so, then keep reading as this could be the role for you. Over 2MM active sellers in 22 countries (and growing) list their products for sale on the Amazon stores. New sellers are a critical part of Amazon's ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the earth's largest selection and lowest prices, and helping them successfully register, onboard, and scale is fundamental to that mission. As a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) on the Seller Success Programs Analytics team, you will be responsible for bringing data to the table, specifically seller anecdotes and business metrics across the new seller journey. The ideal candidate thrives in working in large and complex data warehouse environments, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, is motivated by developing innovative and simplified solutions to solve complex analytical problems and is passionate about working with large data sets and bringing data together to answer business questions and drive change. These analyses and solutions will be fundamental to finding opportunities and creating new programs aimed at accelerating seller registration, onboarding, and growth on Amazon stores. Key job responsibilities Engage with leadership and diversified customer groups to understand the needs and recommend business intelligence solutions. Partner with engineering teams to define the data elements and data structures that the team should leverage to develop critical new seller experience metrics across registration, onboarding, and launch. Design, implement, and support platforms that provide business teams ad-hoc access to large datasets for self service deep dives (eg: data visualization tools for non-tech business users). Interface with business customers, gather requirements and deliver complete reporting solutions. Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions. Participate in strategic & tactical planning discussions. Standardize data and report consumption across all customer groups. Make recommendations for new metrics, techniques, and strategies to improve seller success and program quality metrics. Be connected and influential within the Amazon BIE community, and work with data engineering and software development teams to enable the appropriate capture and storage of key data points. A day in the life You'll partner with product managers, program leaders, and engineering teams across the new seller journey to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, data-driven answers. A typical day mixes deep-dive analysis on registration, onboarding, and launch funnels; building and maintaining metrics, dashboards, and reports that leaders rely on for weekly and monthly business reviews; and gathering requirements from stakeholders to deliver self-service reporting. You'll dig into large, complex datasets to surface opportunities, size the impact of new programs, and influence the roadmap that helps sellers reach their first milestones faster. About the team Seller Success Programs Analytics is the data backbone for Amazon's mission to be the premier destination for new sellers worldwide to launch and grow durable businesses. We measure and improve every step of the new seller journey, from registration and onboarding through to first sale and long-term growth. We operate in a fast-moving, start-up-like environment where analysts have direct impact on strategy and own their metrics end-to-end. jobs.jd: Big Data Laser Analyst Description - Job Summary • We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.​ Responsibilities • Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations. • Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions. • Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations. • Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms. • Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats. • Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls. • Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders. • Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams. • Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members. • Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently. • Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans. Education & Experience Recommended • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. • Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience. Preferred Certifications • Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar) Knowledge & Skills • Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design • SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization • Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally • Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations • Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations • Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs • Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting • Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation • Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence. • Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation Cross-Org Skills • Effective Communication • Results Orientation • Learning Agility • Digital Fluency • Customer Centricity • Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams Impact & Scope • Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs • Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs Complexity • Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines. jobs.title: Data Scientist - Asset Management (Hybrid)

Working closely with investment professionals, business stakeholders, and technology teams, you will design and implement innovative solutions that enhance investment decision-making, streamline operations, and improve business efficiency. You will leverage emerging technologies, including generative AI, machine learning, and modern cloud-based data platforms, to turn complex data and business needs into practical, scalable solutions. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical expertise with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for delivering meaningful business impact through AI and data-driven innovation. Develop and enhance AI-enabled workflows, including document processing, information extraction, summarization, and knowledge retrieval. Collaborate with technology and engineering teams to develop scalable, reusable AI capabilities that can be applied across multiple business functions and use cases. Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies to identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement. Support the testing, validation, monitoring, and ongoing enhancement of AI and data science solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, and business value. Develop data-driven solutions that support investment research, portfolio management, risk analysis, and operational processes. Partner with data engineering and technology teams to support data integration, transformation, and accessibility across investment systems. Develop and enhance analytical tools, reporting capabilities, and data workflows that improve business efficiency and decision-making. Promote effective data management practices, including data quality, governance, and responsible use of enterprise data. Business Partnership and Solution Delivery Partner directly with portfolio managers, investment analysts, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where data science and AI can deliver meaningful business value. Translate business challenges into clearly defined technical requirements, solution designs, and actionable development plans. Collaborate with Enterprise Technology, data engineering, and AI governance teams to design, develop, and implement solutions aligned with enterprise technology standards. Lead or contribute to data science and AI initiatives from initial discovery and prototyping through implementation and ongoing enhancement. Measure and communicate the effectiveness of delivered solutions, including improvements in productivity, accuracy, and operational efficiency. Experience developing and implementing data science, analytics, machine learning, or AI solutions in a business environment. Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI, to develop interactive dashboards, communicate insights, and support data-driven decision-making. Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience working with complex datasets and developing data-driven applications or workflows. Familiarity with generative AI, large language models, and their practical application to business processes. Understanding of cloud computing environments and modern data platforms, such as AWS and Snowflake. Experience working with APIs, data integration processes, and analytical development tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.jd: King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape. The Treasury Analyst supports the firm’s global treasury operations by managing daily liquidity, cash reporting and forecasting, payment execution, bank account administration, and treasury controls. The role analyzes treasury data, supports banking and financial risk activities, and partners with Finance and other business teams to improve processes, strengthen controls, and provide timely, accurate information for decision-making. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Prepare daily cash positions, monitor liquidity across domestic and international accounts, and communicate cash balances and material activity to leadership. Prepare and execute electronic payments and cash transfers through approved banking platforms in accordance with authorization requirements and segregation-of-duties controls. Prepare short- and medium-term cash forecasts, analyze forecast-to-actual variances, and recommend improvements to forecast accuracy. Monitor excess operating cash and execute approved transfers or investment transactions consistent with firm policy. Support day-to-day relationships with domestic and global banking partners, coordinate service requests, and assist with bank fee and service reviews. Administer bank accounts and related documentation, including account openings and closings, authorized signatories, user access, and periodic access reviews. Administer the firm’s credit card programs and respond to internal and external inquiries. Prepare debt covenant calculations, compliance certificates, and related quarterly and annual reporting in accordance with credit agreements. Budget and forecast interest income and expense, analyze variances, and support treasury reporting and dashboards. Assist with letters of credit, rental guarantees, performance guarantees, and other banking instruments. Review and administer escrow and trust arrangements in accordance with firm policies, including related receipts, payments, records, and reconciliations. Support monitoring of foreign currency exposures and approved foreign exchange transactions, as applicable. Maintain treasury documentation and support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and business continuity procedures. Participate in the annual insurance renewal process and coordinate requests for certificates of insurance and other insurance-related information. Support treasury systems and banking-platform administration, data integrity, testing, automation, and process-improvement initiatives. Maintain treasury policies and procedures, identify control or operational gaps, and recommend improvements that strengthen risk management and efficiency. Perform other treasury and finance responsibilities as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field. Three or more years of experience in treasury, banking, corporate finance, or a related area, preferably supporting multi-entity or global operations. Experience with cash positioning, payments, cash forecasting, bank account administration, and online banking platforms. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to analyze financial data, identify variances, and communicate conclusions clearly. Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and collaborate effectively across functions and regions. Experience in a global professional services organization. Familiarity with foreign exchange, investments, debt compliance, financial controls, and audit support. Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or progress toward a relevant professional certification. The firm offers a generous total compensation package with bonuses and raises awarded in recognition of individual merit-based performance. All full-time Business Services employees may participate in King & Spalding’s comprehensive benefit program including health and wellness plan, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts and a health savings account, a 401(k) plan, profit sharing plan, and a substantial Paid Time Off (PTO) program. We seek to attract and develop the very best talent to work with us.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Credit (Retros)
jobs.jd:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.


ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models and insights that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We use Plaid’s unique financial data to help lenders make more informed decisions and build better credit experiences.

We partner across data science, engineering, product, and Go-to-Market to turn complex data into practical customer recommendations and scalable solutions. We value technical rigor, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. You’ll work across customer problems, credit policy, and data products—translating Plaid’s data into recommendations and insights that drive business impact and inform product direction.

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

 - Deep-dive into model performance for clients, triage issues, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes.

 - Analyze Plaid’s unique data to identify emerging credit risk signals and build and evaluate credit retrospectives.

 - Create tailored recommendations for clients based on their data and Plaid’s insights.

 - Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.

 - Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.

 - Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.

 - Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.

 - Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.

 - Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.



WHAT EXCITES YOU

 - Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.

 - Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.

 - Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.

 - Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.

 - Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.



WHAT EXCITES US

 - 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.

 - Deep familiarity with SQL and Python.

 - Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.

 - Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.

 - Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.

 - Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

 - Nice to have: Experience building data pipelines and automating ETL processes with dbt or similar tools.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.



Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice.


Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Vulnerability Management and Remediation
jobs.jd: Do you get excited about working with hyper scale data applications? Interested in security? Enjoy working with the latest and greatest AWS technologies? Ready to pioneer our data analysis, dashboarding, and storage solutions for a pipeline managing petabytes of data to transform the efficiency of our systems and customers? Here in Defensive Security, we have that special role just for you! The Amazon Vulnerability Management Service(AVMS) team is building the next generation of mission critical data processing pipelines and applications. Our innovations handle petabyte scale data, in real time. These applications enable Amazon defensive security and security management teams globally. Our customers are Amazon, internal stakeholders, and Amazon’s customers. Our engineers work directly with stakeholders, get close to customers' needs, and are empowered to take technical risks to build the best-in-class software with respect to quality, scale, and insights. The technical foundation this team builds, helps keep all of Amazon (Fulfillment Centers, Physical Stores, Whole Foods, Fresh, etc.) secure. We need folks who have a passion for building hyper-scale systems that are always online. Those with an entrepreneurial spirit to take risks, experiment with new technical methods, and focus on improving what came before will find themselves perfectly at home in our team. Key job responsibilities - Design, develop, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and ETL pipelines to support business intelligence initiatives using automated dashboard solutions - Partner with Technical, Business, Operation, and Security teams to understand data requirements and design scalable and user-friendly BI solutions - Design and implement AI/LLM-powered solutions to automate human-in-the-loop tasks - Design and develop statistical analysis to support business decision making using the AI infrastructure and company wide solutions - Manage and execute entire project from start to finish including problem solving, data gathering and manipulation, predictive modeling and project management A day in the life A successful candidate will excel at driving multiple concurrent projects, balancing strategic initiatives with urgent operational needs. They must demonstrate the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, accommodate evolving requirements and drive decisions despite ambiguity. You will be part of making the team your own. We believe in a self-organizing team. You will help shape team process, outcomes, and goals as part of interactions with Senior Amazon Leadership. Each day you will achieve new successes as you adapt to Amazon scaling, new bad actors arising, and emerging technologies being added to your portfolio. You will shape, form, and deliver all aspects of the software and operations that your team delivers to enable defensive security and security management success. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training and Career growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. jobs.title: Business Insights Analyst- Branch Network Distribution
jobs.jd: Position Overview Citizens Bank is executing a multi-year transformation of its retail branch network, shifting toward a performance-driven, growth-oriented distribution model and investing in branch reformats, refreshes, closures, de novos, staffing models, and operating-hour changes. The Business Analyst, Branch Network Distribution will support the reporting, analytics, experimentation, and impact measurement used to understand network performance and evaluate whether branch actions are delivering their intended outcomes. The analyst will work with more experienced team members to prepare data, build recurring reporting, conduct structured analyses, and translate findings into clear business insights. This is a hands-on developmental role for an early-career analyst who is eager to build technical, analytical, and business skills while supporting visible priorities across Distribution Transformation, Retail Banking, Marketing, Finance, and the Consumer Bank. Key Responsibilities Network Performance Reporting & Insights Support the development and maintenance of reporting and dashboards that measure branch network performance using leading and lagging indicators. Prepare performance views across banker, branch, market, and enterprise levels to support day-to-day management and longer-term decisions. Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities and summarize findings for review by senior team members and business partners. Branch Action Analytics & Impact Measurement Support analyses that measure the results of branch network actions, including reformats, refreshes, closures, de novos, staffing changes, and changes to operating hours. Assess outcomes across customer behavior, productivity, financial performance, and growth using established analytical approaches. Help account for factors such as market conditions, seasonality, and overlapping initiatives, with guidance from experienced analysts. Experimentation & Test-and-Learn Support Assist in developing pilots and tests with clear objectives, success measures, comparison groups, and evaluation plans. Prepare analyses that help determine whether an initiative should be expanded, refined, or discontinued. Document methods, assumptions, and results so conclusions are transparent and repeatable. Physical Network Marketing Value Analysis Support analysis of the branch network as a customer acquisition, relationship-deepening, and brand asset. Help assess how branch presence, format, and investment relate to customer behavior across channels and over time. Partner with Marketing, Finance, and Distribution colleagues to incorporate relevant data into growth and investment analyses. Data Preparation & Analytical Execution Build working knowledge of branch, banker productivity, customer, marketing, and financial data. Use SQL and tools such as Alteryx, or equivalent tools, to source, cleanse, join, and prepare analytical datasets. Complete quality checks and help maintain consistent metrics, definitions, assumptions, and documentation across analyses and reporting. Business Intelligence & Tool Support Build and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using established data models and team standards. Help improve the automation, performance, usability, and documentation of reporting assets. Learn and apply business intelligence, visualization, and emerging analytical tools to improve productivity while following applicable governance requirements. Business Partnering & Communication Work with team members and business partners to clarify questions, gather requirements, and translate business needs into structured analysis. Prepare clear presentations, summaries, and supporting materials that explain findings, implications, and limitations. Respond thoughtfully to feedback and refine analyses and reporting based on stakeholder needs. Project Support & Continuous Improvement Manage assigned work, meet agreed timelines, and provide clear updates on progress, questions, and risks. Contribute to team projects by completing defined analytical workstreams with guidance and review. Identify practical opportunities to improve data quality, repeatability, speed, and clarity. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. 0-3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, finance, strategy, or a related role; relevant internships, academic projects, or co-op experience may be considered. Foundational SQL skills and experience working with structured data; exposure to Alteryx or a similar data preparation tool is helpful. Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform through work, internships, or academic projects. Working knowledge of analytical methods, including trend analysis, performance measurement, and basic test or comparison design. Ability to organize data, check work carefully, and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner. Interest in financial services, retail banking, customer analytics, or physical distribution is helpful but not required. Leadership & Soft Skills Analytically curious - asks thoughtful questions, looks for patterns, and is eager to understand what the data means Detail-oriented - produces accurate work and checks data, assumptions, and outputs carefully. Clear communicator - explains analysis in straightforward language and adapts based on feedback. Collaborative - works effectively with teammates and business partners and contributes positively to team outcomes. Organized and accountable - manages assigned work, follows through on commitments, and raises questions early. Growth-oriented - seeks feedback, develops new technical and business skills, and applies lessons to future work. Hours & Work Schedule Hours per Week: 40 Work Schedule: Monday - Friday Hybrid: 4 days per week on-site Pay Transparency The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $106,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience. We offer competitive pay , comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits .

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.location: Chicago, United States; New York, United States
jobs.jd: IMC Americas, Inc. has multiple openings for Quantitative Researcher (REQ ID: 4528527101 ) in Chicago, IL and New York, NY. Your Core Responsibilities Collaborate with traders, developers, and researchers to evaluate, validate, and improve quantitative models used in IMC’s proprietary trading strategies through statistical analysis, simulation, and empirical research (10%). Design quantitative methods to gather and analyze market data, trading statistics, or new data sources and use the result of that research as the basis for new trading strategies (10%). Build research-oriented computational tools, simulations, visualizations, and backtesting frameworks to evaluate quantitative hypotheses and measure model performance before production deployment (10%). Formulate trading hypotheses as mathematical, statistical, and machine-learning models; prototype algorithms and coordinate with developers to integrate validated research into trading systems (10%). Apply statistical inference, optimization, numerical methods, and financial mathematics to diagnose model behavior, improve forecasting accuracy, and address complex research problems in proprietary trading (15%). Identify gaps in existing trading algorithms and propose new algorithmic approaches to improve pricing, execution, risk management, or trading performance (10%). Define design requirements for new quantitative trading algorithms, including the intended market behavior, data inputs, model assumptions, implementation constraints, and expected trading impact (10%). Drive complex quantitative research projects from initial problem definition through hypothesis testing, model validation, implementation planning, and post-deployment performance review (10%). Determine whether quantitative models or trading strategies are ready for production deployment by assessing statistical evidence, trading risk, operational constraints, and expected profitability (5%). Prioritize quantitative research initiatives by weighing expected PnL impact, technical feasibility, implementation risk, resource requirements, and strategic value to the trading desk (5%). Mentor graduate quantitative researchers and interns by reviewing research plans, challenging assumptions, evaluating analysis quality, and providing technical guidance on algorithm design, trading research, and model validation (5%). Partial telecommuting permitted. Multiple positions available. Requisition ID: 4528527101 . Your Skills and Experience This position requires a Bachelors degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Financial Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Computational Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative, mathematical, or computational field, and two (2) years of experience in the job offered or a quantitative, technical, and mathematical role or a related position. Must have two (2) years of experience with each of the following skills: Applying statistical inference, optimization, regression analysis, time-series analysis, algorithm design, and other analytical and quantitative techniques to solve complex problems; Designing and implementing mathematical models and algorithms, including optimization, signal-generation, and statistical learning methods; Analyzing large-scale, high-frequency financial time-series datasets — including market data, order book data, trade data, and derived quantitative signals — to identify patterns, evaluate hypotheses, and measure model performance, with experience handling data quality issues such as gaps and outliers; Applying statistical inference, time-series analysis, and model-validation best practices to analyze data and evaluate quantitative research results; Applying concepts from financial theory, financial mathematics, and financial engineering, including market microstructure, derivatives pricing, risk modeling, and portfolio management; Experience collaborating with traders and developers conducting quantitative research for use in a quantitative trading environment; Using Python coding libraries, including Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, Numba, Polars, Dask, Matplotlib to assist in quantitative analysis; Applying quantitative research methodologies for use in quantitative proprietary trading; Using numerical optimization techniques; Building options portfolios; and Developing trading systems that trade on low latency scale at the milisecond granularity. #LI-DNI The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits - US | IMC Trading for more comprehensive information. Salary Range $175,000 — $275,000 USD About Us IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

jobs.title: Consultant -- Azure, Data & AI
jobs.jd: Coretek is seeking an Azure Data & AI Consultant to design, implement, and optimize modern data and AI solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. You will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines, integrating AI services, and ensuring solutions align with industry best practices. This role requires strong technical expertise in Azure data services, experience with AI integration, and the ability to work effectively in a client-facing consulting environment. jobs.jd: Title: Actuarial Analyst, Global Reserving Company: Job Category: Analytics Job Description: Everest Overview Everest is a global leader in risk management, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world. This role will contribute to quarterly reserve studies, financial reporting, reserve monitoring, and automation initiatives while partnering closely with Claims, Underwriting, Finance, and Pricing teams. The position provides a strong foundation for actuaries seeking to deepen their reserving expertise within a collaborative global actuarial organization. The role supports the Global Reserving leadership team and contributes to the organization's objective of delivering trusted actuarial insights that drive disciplined business decisions. Key Responsibilities Support quarterly and year-end reserve studies for assigned lines of business. Analyze accident year development, reserve movements, and actual versus expected results. Prepare reserving exhibits and presentations for management review. Assist with quarter-close activities and actuarial reporting requirements. Collaborate with Claims and Underwriting teams to understand emerging loss trends and portfolio changes. Maintain and enhance reserving models, databases, and reporting tools. jobs.title: PGIM - Investment Analyst, Portfolio Analysis Group
jobs.jd: Job Classification: Investment Management - Investments A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What you will do The Portfolio Analysis Group (PAG) partners closely with investment teams to provide the analytics and insights that support portfolio construction, risk monitoring, performance analysis, and investment decision-making. Our PAG Analyst Program is a three-year rotational program designed to provide broad exposure across asset classes, investment strategies, and portfolio management teams. Analysts complete one-year rotations across PAG and select partner teams, developing a strong foundation in portfolio analytics while gaining firsthand experience across the investment process. Core rotations may include General Account, Investment Grade, High Yield, Emerging Markets, US/Global Rates & Hedge Fund, Structured Products, and Multi-Sector. Satellite rotations may include CLO Structuring, Structured Products Research, and Investment Risk Management. This incoming Analyst will begin the program aligned to our Structured Products / Asset-Based Finance (ABF) team , where they will work closely with Portfolio Managers and other investment partners to analyze portfolio positioning and performance, monitor risk and client objectives, and deliver actionable insights that support day-to-day portfolio management. This position follows a hybrid work model, with working 3 days in the Newark, NJ office and 2 days remote. What you can expect Analyze portfolio positioning relative to benchmarks, client objectives, risk parameters, and investment goals, identifying changes in exposures and opportunities to improve portfolio alignment. Produce portfolio analytics and performance attribution to help explain investment results and inform portfolio management decisions. Incorporate client guidelines, investment objectives, and risk tolerances into portfolio monitoring, scenario analysis, and portfolio management workflows. Partner with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Risk Managers, Quantitative teams, Credit Research, Client Advisory, technology partners, and senior PAG team members. Support timely market, portfolio, and client analyses while improving recurring reports, analytical tools, and repeatable processes. What you will bring Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of relevant experience in investment management, financial services, portfolio or risk analytics, research, or a related analytical field. Proficiency with Excel and familiarity with investment and data analytics tools such as Bloomberg, Aladdin, SQL, and Python preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, actionable insights. A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across investment, risk, research, and technology teams. What will set you apart Strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to problem solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced investment environment. Exposure to coding best practices, including documentation, version control, testing, peer review, and writing maintainable code. Pursuit of the CFA designation or an MBA is a plu s. *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. Note : Prudential is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $90,000 to $100,000. Specific pricing for the role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Roles may also be eligible for additional compensation and/or benefits. Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. #LI-SC1 #LI-Hybrid What we offer you: Market competitive base salaries, with a yearly bonus potential at every level. Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), and leave of absences, such as parental and military leave. 401(k) plan with company match (up to 4%). Company-funded pension plan. Wellness Programs including up to $1,600 a year for reimbursement of items purchased to support personal wellbeing needs. Work/Life Resources to help support topics such as parenting, housing, senior care, finances, pets, legal matters, education, emotional and mental health, and career development. Education Benefit to help finance traditional college enrollment toward obtaining an approved degree and many accredited certificate programs. Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Shares can be purchased at 85% of the lower of two prices (Beginning or End of the purchase period). Eligibility to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. To find out more about our Total Rewards package, visit Work Life Balance | Prudential Careers. Some of the above benefits may not apply to part-time employees scheduled to work less than 20 hours per week. jobs.title: Treasury Digital Assets Analyst
jobs.jd: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Join Visa Treasury's Digital Assets and Innovation team to help reshape how money moves with digital assets like stablecoins and next-gen payment rails. In this role, you'll own operations end to end, develop treasury roadmaps, and guide decisions, partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Settlement Ops, Finance, and Product to vet ideas and design and launch pilots with external partners. You'll keep a close pulse on the crypto ecosystem and turn research into clear recommendations. We're looking for someone who brings big ideas and takes ownership, yet stays grounded in treasury fundamentals like liquidity, settlement, reconciliation, and controls. This role is perfect if you're ready to roll up your sleeves, move fast, and help define the next chapter of money movement at Visa. Key Responsibilities: Run daily treasury operations across digital assets and traditional payments, including cash, liquidity, settlement, and reconciliation. Execute treasury activities across blockchains, custodians, wallets, banks, exchanges, and payment providers. Participate in a rotating weekend and after-hours support model for critical treasury operations and incident response. Monitor fiat and digital asset liquidity, funding needs, and operational risk controls. Support stablecoin operations, including minting, redemption, custody transfers, wallet funding, and exception management. Own settlement, reconciliation, operational controls, audit readiness, and issue resolution processes. Improve runbooks, procedures, controls, and escalation frameworks. Track KPIs and operational metrics; provide actionable insights to leadership. Assess opportunities and risks across digital asset use cases, focusing on liquidity, efficiency, settlement, and working capital impacts. Monitor developments across blockchain, stablecoin, custody, payments, and regulatory ecosystems. Create executive-ready presentations, strategy memos, and business recommendations. Lead pilot execution from planning through launch, including governance, testing, vendor diligence, and operational readiness. Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions. jobs.jd: About Invesco As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. We develop models, analytics, and research tools used by portfolio managers across fundamental credit, rates, securitized, multi-sector, and systematic investment teams. The team works collaboratively to translate investment research into practical portfolio applications. Your Role As a Senior Quantitative Researcher, you will serve as a quantitative research partner to portfolio managers across Invesco Fixed Income. You will conduct empirical research on fixed income markets, macroeconomic drivers, and relative-value opportunities and translate your findings into portfolio construction, asset allocation, and risk-management applications. You will independently lead research projects from hypothesis development and testing through implementation and production deployment. You will work closely with portfolio managers, economists, traders, fundamental analysts, and quantitative engineers across the fixed income platform. You Will Be Responsible For: Conducting empirical research on fixed income markets, macroeconomic drivers, relative value, and cross-asset relationships and translating the findings into actionable investment frameworks. Building tactical and strategic sector and asset-allocation models across credit, rates, securitized products, and emerging markets that connect macroeconomic and market views to portfolio positioning. Designing and improving portfolio-construction and optimization frameworks for fundamental and systematic portfolios, incorporating transaction costs, liquidity, turnover, concentration, and other practical investment constraints. Developing risk, scenario-analysis, and performance-attribution tools that improve investment decision-making and provide transparency into return drivers, factor exposures, and tracking error. Partnering with portfolio managers, traders, economists, and other investment professionals to translate investment ideas into scalable research, analytics, and portfolio-implementation frameworks. Developing shared research tools, reusable analytical libraries, and data pipelines using production-quality code, version control, testing, documentation, and peer review. Supporting the research, design, and launch of new fixed income strategies and contributing to client-facing research, presentations, and investment materials. Leading defined research projects, mentoring junior colleagues, and contributing to consistent standards for research design, testing, documentation, and production implementation. The Experience You Bring: Seven or more years of quantitative research experience in fixed income or multi-asset investing at an asset manager, hedge fund, bank, insurance company, pension fund, or index provider. A master’s degree or PhD in statistics, financial engineering, economics, operations research, mathematics, physics, computer science, or another relevant quantitative discipline. Advanced Python skills, including experience with analytical libraries such as pandas or Polars, NumPy, SciPy, and statsmodels, together with strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Git. Practical experience with factor models, time-series econometrics, portfolio optimization, and empirical investment research. Strong knowledge of fixed income instruments and risk, including duration, yield curves, credit spreads, credit quality, liquidity, and benchmark-relative risk. Experience taking quantitative research from hypothesis development and testing through implementation in a live investment or production environment. Ability to independently solve complex research problems, exercise sound judgment, evaluate alternative approaches, and clearly communicate recommendations. Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to non-quantitative investment professionals, build consensus, and work effectively across fundamental, quantitative, and technical teams. Preferred Experience Experience supporting fundamental fixed income portfolio managers or conducting multi-sector allocation research, including macro-conditioned models, risk budgeting, or long-horizon return forecasting. Systematic credit or rates experience involving bond-level factor signals, TRACE data, index-constituent data, liquidity analysis, or transaction-cost modeling. Experience with institutional risk and portfolio platforms such as Aladdin, Bloomberg PORT, BarraOne, or Axioma and fixed income data from providers such as Bloomberg or ICE. Experience applying machine-learning techniques with disciplined validation and economic interpretation in noisy financial datasets. Familiarity with cloud data platforms, scalable quantitative research environments, and AI-assisted development and research tools. CFA designation or progress toward the designation. You will work directly with operational teams to extract signal from complex sensor, equipment, and process data, build production-grade anomaly detection and forecasting systems, and drive the adoption of Agentic AI solutions across a global organization spanning semiconductor manufacturing, facilities operations, and engineering. This role is not about building models in isolation. It involves solving problems in complex operational environments, earning the trust of domain experts, and deploying intelligent systems that scale. About You You are an experienced data scientist energized by ambiguous, high-stakes problems. You can walk into a room with facilities engineers and operations specialists, ask the right questions, and leave with a clear picture of what needs to be modeled. You do not just build models - you understand the operational problem deeply enough to know when a simpler statistical approach beats a complex neural network. You are self-directed. You stay current with emerging technologies - including agentic AI frameworks and large language model tooling - not because it is trendy, but because you know how to apply them where they genuinely move the needle in a manufacturing environment. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.jd:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

 - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

 - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

 - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

 - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest.

 - Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.

Qualifications

 - Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads.

 - Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business.

 - Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.

NPX https://www.npx.ca/ partners with nuclear utilities and new reactor projects to unlock performance through innovation. You’ll build pipelines in Databricks, shape the data into solid models, and design Power BI dashboards that give plant and project teams a clear, trusted view of how their work is performing.

You’ll work directly with clients and alongside our developers, product managers, and designers, owning your work from the first requirements conversation through to a dashboard people actually use.

 - Exposure to lakehouse design and data platform architecture decisions.

 - Learn from the inside: Work alongside nuclear industry veterans, data specialists, and developers who know how plants really operate.

jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

 - Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

 - Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.
   
   

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.
   
   

What you bring

 - 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

 - Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

 - Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and comfort operating in a fast-moving, undefined space.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: AI Research Resident (Algorithms Codesign)
jobs.jd:
NORMAL COMPUTING | BUILD WITH US

Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London.


THE RESIDENCY PROGRAM

The AI Research Residency is Normal Computing's flagship program for exceptional researchers and engineers who want to work at the frontier of AI. Residents join a small, hand-picked cohort with a dedicated research mentor, direct access to the team developing the algorithms for our in-memory inference hardware, and a clear arc from onboarding through publication.

Every residency is built around two milestones that mark you as part of something bigger than a single project: a research paper co-authored with our team, and a company-wide research colloquium where you present your findings to the full Normal Computing organization. You'll leave with a body of published, presented work, and a standing as one of the earliest residents to help define what this program becomes.


THIS TRACK: ALGORITHMS CODESIGN

Normal's hardware runs the most memory-bound parts of large-model inference inside memory itself, rather than shuttling weights to a processor. The software that makes this programmable doesn't exist yet in any standard form. This track is about the computational methods that make LLM inference run efficiently on it: rethinking how operations like attention, memory access, and long-context decoding should behave on hardware that computes inside memory, rather than adapting standard GPU kernels to a new chip.

You'll work on this as a co-design problem. The hardware and the algorithms are developed in parallel, so your findings feed architectural decisions rather than implementing against a fixed specification. You'll validate ideas against our simulators and FPGA prototypes first, and against silicon as it arrives.


YOUR NORMAL EXPERIENCE

This is a hands-on research residency: you'll take ownership of a real technical problem in inference algorithms for in-memory compute, work alongside the researchers and engineers building our platform, and be expected to contribute ideas, not just execute someone else's. Your job is to help turn research into production-quality research code that a team can build on. Outside-of-the-box thinking is encouraged.

You'll get direct exposure to the pace, ambiguity, and speed of decision-making that comes with working at a fast-moving, well-funded startup, where the distance between an idea on a whiteboard and a result on real hardware is measured in weeks, not years.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Develop inference algorithms for in-memory hardware. Understand which parts of LLM workloads are best suited to in-memory execution and develop algorithms that exploit it natively, demonstrated first in simulation and then on hardware.

Design numerical methods that fit the physics. Design methods that exploit thermal noise and analog dynamics rather than working around them.

Build evaluation suites and benchmarks. Help build the evaluation frameworks and benchmarks that characterize how algorithms behave on real hardware and in simulation, and tell us honestly whether any of it actually works.

Translate workloads into hardware constraints. Turn insights about model workloads into constraints and opportunities for the hardware and architecture teams.

Prototype and iterate rapidly. Move with the hardware as it evolves from simulation to FPGA to silicon.

Drive a research question of your own. Partner with researchers and engineers to scope, run, and iterate on an original technical investigation, with rigorous experimental analysis and documentation along the way.

Co-author a paper. Work with the team to write up your findings for submission to a relevant venue, with mentorship on framing, experiments, and technical writing. One of the two milestones every resident builds toward.

Present at the residency colloquium. Share your work and thinking with the broader Normal Computing research community at the program's capstone event, and get real-time feedback from people building this technology every day.


WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

Currently pursuing or recently completed a graduate degree (MS or PhD, or equivalent research experience) in machine learning, applied mathematics, physics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field. Publications are a strong plus, but not required at the resident level; a solid research track record is what matters.

A working understanding of large model inference: attention mechanisms, KV cache, long-context decoding, memory bandwidth constraints. Deep production experience isn't expected at the resident level, but the intuition should feel familiar.

Some exposure to inference optimization (quantization, sparsity, kernel fusion, or memory-efficient attention), or to stochastic systems, probabilistic methods, numerical analysis, or analog computation.

Strong Python skills, plus some experience with a systems language (C++, Rust, or similar) or with implementing algorithms close to hardware, beyond high-level frameworks.

Some experience (course projects, research, or otherwise) turning a research idea into working, reasonably reproducible code. You care about whether results replicate, not just whether a demo works once.

Comfort reasoning from first principles about what a novel substrate can do efficiently.

Bonus: exposure to analog or mixed-signal systems, in-memory compute, or non-von-Neumann architectures; publications or open-source work in efficient inference, stochastic algorithms, or novel computing; or experience working on hardware that did not yet exist when you joined.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; prior experience writing up research (papers, theses, technical reports) is a plus, as is any experience presenting technical work to a live audience.

A bias toward ownership and self-direction. You're energized, not overwhelmed, by the ambiguity and speed of a small, fast-moving startup.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Privacy Notice
